preconditions.description: The length of str1 is at least 1 and at most 1000.
The length of str2 is at least 1 and at most 1000.
All characters in str1 are lowercase English letters.
All characters in str2 are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The function must return a non-None value.
All characters in the returned value are lowercase English letters.
The string str1 is a subsequence of the returned value.
The string str2 is a subsequence of the returned value.

postconditions.expression: not any(str1 in s and str2 in s for s in alternatives) or return_value in alternatives
postconditions.description: If there are multiple shortest common supersequences, the returned value is one of them. If there is only one, it does not matter which one is returned.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == min(len(s) for s in alternatives) if alternatives else True
postconditions.description: The length of the returned value is the minimum length among all possible shortest common supersequences.
